image_description: A macro close-up shot featuring two white daisy-like flowers. The primary subject is a flower on the left, shown in partial profile, revealing multiple layers of white ray petals and a glimpse of a yellow center. A second flower is visible on the right, slightly out of focus, showing its yellow disc and white petals. The background is dark and indistinct, emphasizing the floral subjects. The lighting is soft, highlighting the texture and translucency of the petals.
